data.long_meaning: Rabaa is derived from the Arabic word ‘rab’a which means 'four' and ‘rabwa’ which means 'grace' or 'butterfly'. This name symbolizes the beauty, grace and peacefulness of a butterfly, often associated with the beginning of a new life. The name Rabaa carries the meaning “Butterfly” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Rabaa usually hope their child will grow to embody butterfly and live with faith, good character and purpose.
